clips.title: The story
paras: 'Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds' is a quest that leads adventurers out of Northshire Valley to track wandering kobolds into Elwynn Forest. Using a tracking kit, players discover the trail leads toward the infested Fargodeep Mine and report the findings to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

As the kobold infestation in Northshire Valley escalates, signs indicate that the vermin are organizing beyond the isolated abbey grounds. Equipped with a tracking kit, scouts are dispatched to follow the trail of the creatures to determine where they are concentrating their efforts. This reconnaissance serves as a crucial bridge between Northshire's local troubles and the broader defense of Elwynn Forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.
Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.
Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.
